reusable_ast_function_closures.code:
def convert(src, u, m):
    (X, *_) = src.flows(u)
    g = np.arange(m.B) * m.L
    b = np.minimum(g // src.L, src.B - 1)
    v = np.zeros(m.n)
    v[:m.p] = X[g - b * src.L + 1, b].ravel()
    h = min(m.M, src.M)
    v[m.sf[:h]] = u[src.sf[:h]]
    v[m.st] = u[src.st]
    return v
